name: Jahleel
title: Son of Zebulun
summary: Jahleel was the third son of Zebulun, who was the son of Jacob and Leah. He was the founder of the clan of the Jahleelites and went with his family to Egypt during Joseph's time. He is mentioned in the genealogies as one of the patriarchs of Israel.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Jahleel as Son of Zebulun
keyEvents.description: Jahleel was born as the third son of Zebulun, son of Jacob and Leah, and became part of the twelve tribes of Israel.

keyEvents.title: The Journey to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Jahleel was among Jacob's descendants who went down to Egypt with his father Zebulun and all of Jacob's household, a total of seventy people.

keyEvents.title: Founder of the Jahleelite clan
keyEvents.description: Jahleel became the ancestor of the Jahleelite clan, one of the clans within the tribe of Zebulun, which was recorded during the census in the wilderness.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Zebulun in the genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jahleel is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as part of the genealogies of the sons of Israel, where the sons of Zebulun are listed.

keyEvents.title: Census of the tribe of Zebulun
keyEvents.description: The Jahleelites were counted as part of the tribe of Zebulun during the second census on the plains of Moab by the Jordan, opposite Jericho.
